title: HPV Integration and Tumorigenesis of Uterine Cervical Adenocarcinoma
brief_summary: This study aims to analyze the multi-omics results between uterine cervical adenocarcinoma patients with and without human papillomavirus (HPV) infections. The multi-omics profiles include genome wide association study (GWAS), whole exome sequencing, analysis of transcriptomics and metabolomics. The HPV integration status is interpreted by GWAS. A comprehensive multi-omics will reveal the role of HPV integration in the molecular mechanism of tumorigenesis and prognosis of uterine cervical adenocarcinoma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed primary adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix
* Signed an approved informed consents
* Feasible for biopsy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not meeting all of the inclusion criteria
study_population: All patients confirmed primary adenocarcinoma of the uterine cervix
